user_story: As a guest, I want cancelling an already-cancelled booking to return a clear error so that duplicate cancellations are handled.

positive.title: Successful cancellation of an active booking
steps: User logs in as a guest.
User selects an active booking to cancel.
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully cancelled and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel an already cancelled booking
steps: User logs in as a guest.
User selects a booking that has already been cancelled.
User attempts to cancel the booking again.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed saying 'This booking is already cancelled and cannot be cancelled again.'

edge.title: Cancel a booking after the cancellation period has expired
steps: User logs in as a guest.
User selects a booking that is already cancelled and the cancellation period has expired.
User attempts to cancel the booking again.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed saying 'This booking is already cancelled and cannot be cancelled again.'
